in_marathi.name: Manjunatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Knowledge and Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manjunatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manjunatha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Manju’ (jewel) and ‘Natha’ (lord or god). This name signifies the god of knowledge and wisdom, a deity revered for his profound understanding and enlightenment. In Hindu mythology, Manjunatha is often depicted as a form of Lord Shiva, the god of regeneration and destruction, symbolizing the cycle of life and death.
